Pipeline & Opportunity Ownership

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Agentic Developer Experience Engineering team led by Benoit Lateltin, AI Transformation Program Lead.

The team currently consists of 3 Software Engineers, 100% dedicated to building the agentic tooling powering all of Mirakl Labs. Together, you'll be designing, shipping and running AI agents and assistants that transform how 330+ engineers, Product Managers, Designers and QAs work every day.

Please note this role requires to be based 4 days at the office, per week.

Your Impact

  • Build agents and assistants as products - across the full software development lifecycle (code review, tech design, maintenance, incident response), from first prototype to tools teams genuinely rely on every day.
  • Define and expand AI delegation safely - set the human control points, guardrails and evaluation frameworks; measure the autonomy rate per task type and extend what agents handle as trust builds over time.
  • Turn team pain points into working software - sit with engineers, PMs, QAs and designers to find the real friction, prototype fast, pilot with volunteer squads, and scale what works.
  • Build the knowledge infrastructure agents consume - along with tooling for usage, cost and impact monitoring, leveraging the Data & Agentic Platform and DevExp foundations rather than rebuilding them from scratch.
  • Make every product measurable - adoption rate, time saved, quality, cost: nothing ships without its metrics.

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, Developer Productivity, or related fields
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals, with experience building reliable, maintainable and production-ready systems
  • Hands-on experience building and operating AI-powered products, using LLMs, RAG and AI Agents
  • Experience applying AI to software development workflows, such as code review, technical design, testing, documentation, maintenance or incident response
  • Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and integrating developer tools, code repositories, CI/CD pipelines, issue trackers or documentation platforms
  • Experience evaluating AI systems and improving their reliability, quality and level of autonomy, through appropriate evaluation frameworks and human-in-the-loop mechanisms
  • Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments
  • Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate closely with engineers and cross-functional teams
  • Curiosity, pragmatism and a strong product mindset, with a passion for turning real developer pain points into useful AI-powered solutions
  • Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can better understand what you have built and worked on!

 

Tech Stack

  • Java, Python, TypeScript
  • Agentic stack: Coding Agents (Claude Code, OpenCode, pi.dev) , MCP (Model Context Protocol), LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, open-source models), evaluation frameworks
  • Infrastructure: GitHub Actions/CI, Kubernetes, Datadog

 

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.

Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application. This helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

Interview steps:

  1. 30/45-minute call with someone from the recruitment team to discuss your key projects, ask technical questions, and present the position in details
  2. 45-minute technical interview on Google Meet with a member of our Labs teams to discuss our technical stack and assess your knowledge
  3. 1-hour business discussion with Benoit, to have a better understanding of the team and its stakes 
  4. 2 x 45-minute STAR interviews to assess your alignment with our values and meet other stakeholders you'll be interacting with

description:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Government team are looking for experienced Consultants and Senior Consultants to join our Central Government practice  

Following the continued growth of Baringa, we are excited to be building our Central Government practice. We are looking for amazing consultants who will thrive with us as we grow. 

We work on the Government’s most complex changes across Central Government departments, helping our clients turn policy into delivery and better service citizens throughout the UK. Our Central Government team works at the heart of UK Government, partnering with HMRC, DWP, Cabinet Office, HM Treasury and many other central Whitehall departments.  

The UK public sector faces major challenges over the coming years, as well as opportunities to drive the recently laid out missions. If you are excited about working alongside our clients to solve their challenges, then we could be what you are looking for. 
 
We are supporting the public sector’s most important programmes across Whitehall and the wider public sector, using our skills in Strategy and Business Cases, Project Delivery, Operational Delivery, DDaT and Government Commercial. 

What you will be doing

  • Conducting structured analysis and modelling to assess the impact of new or proposed policies (e.g. in tax, welfare, digitisation, AI etc.), and translating insights into practical recommendations that account for how they will be implemented and operated  
  • Supporting the development of robust business cases, funding submissions and options appraisals for new services or ways of working across government
  • Contributing to the design of operating models, service blueprints and delivery approaches for new or evolving government functions
  • Supporting the delivery of transformation programmes that improve citizen outcomes, fiscal security and operational resilience  
  • Analysing and improving front- and back-office processes in Critical National Infrastructure and sensitive environments  
  • Working alongside client teams to embed change, track benefits and support sustainable implementation  
  • Contributing to digital, data and analytics initiatives (including AI-enabled solutions), working with specialists to solve complex data challenges and support evidence-led decision-making
  • Bringing relevant best practice from industry and across government into client work  
  • Supporting commercial and procurement activities, including market engagement, option development and evaluation
  • Using approved AI tools responsibly to improve the efficiency, quality and accessibility of our work
  • Working inclusively across multi-disciplinary Baringa and client teams, creating an environment in which different perspectives are valued
  • Contributing to the Central Government practice through communities of practice in our expert groups and developing our core propositions
  • Developing your understanding of Central Government priorities, departmental challenges and wider Government trends, and applying this insight to our client work and propositions
  • Contributing to proposals, client conversations, thought leadership and the development of new or evolving service offerings 
  • Building trusted networks across clients, partners and within Baringa 

Grade differentiation: Your Skills and experience

  • As a Consultant you will take personal ownership of high-quality analysis and deliverables, work closely with clients, break work into clear activities and milestones and colleagues and proactively seek the input required to deliver effectively 
  • As a Senior Consultant, you will bring a proven record of delivery for government clients and will additionally shape and lead workstreams or significant deliverables, set out a credible end-to-end approach, manage risks and dependencies, guide junior colleagues, build trusted client relationships and identify opportunities to create further value 

Your Skills and experience  

  • Experience working in, or delivering projects for, government or public sector organisations, ideally within a professional services / civil service / consulting environment 
  • A strong interest in working with Central Government departments (e.g. HMRC, DWP, Cabinet Office, HM Treasury, DBT, DfE, MHCLG)  
  • Ability to structure ambiguous problems, analyse data and information, and communicate clear, evidence-based insights  
  • Confidence working collaboratively with client teams and internal specialists in fast-paced, delivery-focused environments  
  • Where your background is in policy, a clear track record of taking policy into delivery – for example shaping implementation plans, working with operational, digital or commercial teams, and managing risks and dependencies through to go-live  
  • Curiosity and interest in technology, digital, data and/or AI, and how these can be applied to improve public services  
  • Confidence using digital and AI tools responsibly and ethically in your day-to-day work, applying judgement to validate outputs. 
  • Strong understanding of how to use digital and AI tools, responsibly and ethically in your day-to-day work. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messages for different audiences  
  • A genuine motivation to improve outcomes for citizens and public servants 
  • All roles will require a level of security clearance; BPSS OR Security Clearance OR Developed Vetting.

Optional skills / experience based on specific technical skillset:  
 
Alongside an expectation of flexibility to respond to our clients’clients greatest needs, we expect candidates to bring depth in one or more of the following areas: 

Strategy, policy into delivery and business cases

  • Policy analysis and options appraisal, with clear line of sight to implementation and operational delivery 
  • Strategic, economic, commercial, financial and management case development 
  • Cost-benefit, economic or fiscal modelling 
  • Benefits management and evaluation 
  • Funding submissions and spending-review support 
  • Communicating technical analysis to non-specialist decision-makers

Programme and project delivery

  • Programme mobilisation, planning and governance 
  • RAID, dependency and milestone management 
  • Portfolio or programme management office capability 
  • Delivery assurance and recovery 
  • Benefits realisation 
  • Working across departmental or organisational boundaries 

Operating model and operational excellence

  • Target operating model design 
  • Organisational and role design 
  • Process analysis and redesign 
  • Lean, systems thinking or other operational-excellence approaches 
  • Service management, operational performance and productivity 
  • Implementation planning and transition into business as usual 

Digital, data, technology and AI

  • User-centred service development 
  • Business analysis and requirements definition 
  • Service design and service assessment 
  • Data strategy, analysis or governance 
  • Responsible AI use-case identification, design and implementation 
  • Digital transformation in legacy and highly controlled environments 
  • Working effectively with multidisciplinary digital and technical teams 

Commercial and procurement

  • Commercial strategy and operating-model development 
  • Market analysis and market engagement 
  • Sourcing strategy and procurement delivery 
  • Evaluation design and supplier selection 
  • Contract mobilisation and supplier management 
  • Commercial risk, value for money and contract performanc

 

What a career at Baringa will give you

Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

Join us

All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. Please contact a member of our Recruitment Team to discuss further.

 

Baringa Privacy Notices

For UK & EU

Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our UK Recruitment Privacy Notice / EU Recruitment Privacy Notice, to evaluate your application and meet our legal and reporting obligations. In line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to request access to, rectification, or erasure (subject to legal limitations) of your personal data. Your personal data may be retained by Baringa for up to two years, as outlined in our Recruitment Privacy Notice (AMER & APAC), to support the recruitment process and internal reporting requirements. Where applicable, and in accordance with relevant federal and state laws, you may have the right to request access to or correction of your personal information. For further details, please contact For Australia & Singapore

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Digital risk, cyber security and resilience are no longer cost centres – they are where value is won or lost

 

The Jaguar Land Rover cyber attack cost the company £196m and had a £1.9bn impact on the UK economy. The damage wasn't a data breach, it was an attack on the connected technology that runs the business. We protect the things which underpin our daily lives: energy, water, payments, banking, hospitals and critical public services – and the supply chains behind them.

We don't just advise clients; we design, build and stand up the frameworks, operating models and tooling that keep working long after we leave.

We're a specialist team scaling fast, and we're independent by design: no software to resell, no audit relationship to protect, so nothing shapes our advice except the problem in front of you.

We work in small teams of experienced consultants, so everyone has a voice. Quarterly promotion cycles and no quotas mean you are promoted when you are ready, not when a slot opens up.

We're looking for Consultants and Senior Consultants who want to be known for tackling our clients’ toughest problems in digital risk, security and resilience.

 

Our Digital Risk and Cyber practice is scaling fast, and we're looking for experienced Consultants who want to build and solve, not just advise

 

 

Our Digital Risk and Cyber (DRC) team helps clients secure the things that matter most – from their overall security strategy and operating model, to the specific technologies that drive value in their business. Our work is organised around two specialisms:

Digital Resilience: helping clients meet fast-moving security, resilience and regulatory obligations such as the Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF), the EU’s Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) and EU AI Act, and the UK Cyber Security and Resilience Bill.

Digital Trust: helping clients govern emerging technology and security risk, including AI, cloud and post-quantum cryptography.

We also build security into our clients' biggest change and transformation programmes, and run the regulatory and standards compliance work that underpins their operations.

We are independent by design. With no software to resell and no audit relationship to protect, our people can give a genuinely honest view – and be trusted advisors in the truest sense.

 

What you will be doing

 

  • Own the work: Take personal ownership of high-quality deliverables on complex engagements – shaping the approach, managing workstreams and making sure what we produce has real impact for the client.
  • Go deep: Build genuine depth in a specialism you care about, and become the go-to expert colleagues and clients rely on to get the hardest calls right.
  • Solve, don't just advise: Design frameworks, build operating models and stand up tooling that clients actually use – using AI to compress high-volume work, so your time is spent on the judgement.
  • Be the critical friend: Advise CISOs and their teams directly across financial services, energy, government and critical national infrastructure – balancing technical depth, commercial understanding and the relationships that make advice land.
  • Help build the business: Grow your network and profile, contribute to new and evolving propositions, put yourself forward for the right opportunities, and spot ways to create more value for clients.
  • Grow – and grow others: Own your development, and support and coach the people around you to be at their best. 

Your skills and experience  

 

We care more about the shape of your experience than a checklist. If most of the following sound like you, we'd love to hear from you:

  • Digital risk and cyber experience: a track record in digital risk, cyber security or resilience, whether gained in consulting or in-house, and a genuine passion for the field.
  • Frameworks and standards: working knowledge of the standards and frameworks that shape our work, for example NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and the regulatory agenda, for example the EU AI Act, DORA, the UK Cyber Security and Resilience Bill and CAF.

  • Certifications: CISSP, ISO, AI regulation and other certifications are a plus, but don’t replace real world experience.
  • Building tooling and automation: hands-on with building, for example agentic AI, Power BI, Power Apps, risk quantification models or digital twins.

As a Technician at Proxima Fusion, you'll work hands-on with Proxima-designed components, magnets, mechanical assemblies and other critical systems, supporting their build, assembly, integration and testing. Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, you'll help turn ambitious designs into reliable hardware, solve practical challenges on the shop floor and contribute to developing the processes and tooling needed to build Alpha. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced engineering and hands-on manufacturing, helping build one of Europe's most ambitious engineering projects. WHAT YOU WILL DO Build, assemble and modify prototypes, experimental hardware, custom tooling and development rigs for engineering and special projects across the programme. Turn engineering drawings, models, and sketches into practical hardware. Clarify missing requirements and agree the build approach with the responsible engineer before committing to uncertain or irreversible steps. Fabricate and adapt components using fitting, cutting, drilling, soldering, bonding and assembly techniques within your competence. Coordinate specialist machining, welding or other work when needed. Identify buildability issues early, including tolerance stacks, inaccessible fasteners, component fit and assembly sequence, and provide practical feedback to the design team. Prepare and run development trials, including winding, joining, insulation and impregnation trials as assigned. Install instrumentation, commission rigs with engineers, take measurements and record what changed and what happened. Investigate unexpected behaviour, propose practical fixes and work through build-test-modify iterations with engineers. Organise the practical delivery of assigned projects: source small parts and consumables through agreed purchasing routes, arrange tools and build activities, and keep the workshop ready for use. Communicate progress, blockers and changing priorities to the lead technician. Keep clear as-built records, annotated drawings, photographs, settings and trial observations so another technician can reproduce the work and understand each modification. Transfer proven prototypes and methods to manufacturing or routine testing through initial work instructions, tooling, assembly sequences, training and technical handovers. Work with engineers to identify hazards and establish the necessary risk assessments and controls before starting work on unproven hardware. WHO YOU ARE A technical apprenticeship or vocational qualification in mechanical, electrical, mechatronic or related engineering work, or equivalent hands-on experience. Hands-on experience building, modifying and troubleshooting mechanical or electromechanical hardware in a workshop, laboratory, development or advanced manufacturing environment. The ability to interpret engineering drawings, tolerances and 3D models, with working familiarity with geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T) and practical measurement skills. Confident hand-tool and workshop skills, sound fabrication and assembly judgement, and a willingness to develop unfamiliar techniques. Resourcefulness with incomplete information: you investigate, ask useful questions, find suitable parts and propose a practical next step while keeping the engineering objective clear. Sound judgement about technical uncertainty, safety and when a build or design change requires engineering review before proceeding. The ability to organise work, adapt to agreed priority changes and document configurations and findings clearly. Working English for technical discussions, drawings, instructions and build records. Experience creating or modifying simple parts and fixtures in CATIA, SolidWorks, Fusion 360 or similar CAD tools. Experience with instrumentation, sensors, data acquisition, electrical wiring, vacuum, cryogenics or superconducting hardware. Experience with composites, resins, vacuum bagging, insulation or impregnation. Experience taking first-of-a-kind hardware or a prototype process through to repeatable manufacturing and technical handover. German language skills. description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

The best global media plans don’t simply roll out across markets—they connect a clear global direction with what works locally.

At WPP Media, we’re looking for a Global Client Director to bring that connection to life for a key international client. You’ll lead the day-to-day account operations and media planning delivery across markets, creating clarity, momentum and quality from brief through to measurement.

As part of our Global Client Solutions team in the Netherlands, you’ll work closely with the Senior Client Leadership Director, Client Manager and specialists across strategy, investment, activation, data and measurement. You’ll also bring diverse market teams together, helping them deliver connected, locally relevant work.

What you’ll do

Lead planning across markets

  • Own the end-to-end media planning process, establishing clear planning cycles, ways of working, timelines, milestones, responsibilities and approval processes.
  • Turn client briefs into actionable media briefs. Challenge gaps and align objectives, audiences, budgets, KPIs, deliverables and timings before planning begins.
  • Translate global strategy and priorities into clear direction for local markets, creating consistency where it adds value while allowing for local insight and relevance.
  • Bring strategy, audience insights, channel planning, investment, activation, data and measurement teams together to shape integrated recommendations.
  • Review and challenge market plans, ensuring they’re strategically sound and clearly explain channel roles, audiences, investment levels, phasing and expected outcomes.

Keep delivery and learning on track

  • Own the planning calendar and keep global and local teams aligned on deadlines, dependencies and next steps.
  • Maintain visibility of media budgets, ensuring investment decisions and changes are clearly documented and communicated.
  • Identify risks, missing inputs and potential delays early—and take action to keep delivery moving.
  • Embed KPIs and measurement requirements into plans from the start, then turn results and market learnings into improvements for future planning.
  • Continuously improve planning templates, workflows and governance to raise quality, consistency and efficiency.

Lead the client relationship and support growth

  • Act as a senior day-to-day client contact, providing clear updates on planning progress, decisions, risks and next steps.
  • Build strong relationships across client marketing, media, procurement and specialist teams, involving the right people at the right stages.
  • Listen to client feedback and turn it into practical actions. Resolve issues proactively and escalate when needed, while keeping ownership clear.
  • Support the Client Growth Plan by identifying opportunities to improve and expand the services WPP Media provides.
  • Partner with commercial and investment leads on scope, resourcing, forecasting and profitability. Spot additional requirements early and ensure they’re appropriately scoped.
  • Identify where WPP Media’s tools, platforms, data and specialist capabilities can strengthen the client’s planning and delivery.

A global mindset

Every market is different. Media landscapes, consumer behaviour, costs, channel maturity and local requirements vary from country to country. You’ll know how to create a consistent approach without applying a one-size-fits-all plan.

You’ll also bring markets together—sharing best practice and making sure individual market learnings help improve planning across the wider account.

What you’ll bring

  • At least five years’ experience in client leadership, account management or media planning, ideally working with international or multi-market clients.
  • A strong understanding of the end-to-end media planning process, from brief and strategy through channel planning, investment, activation and measurement.
  • Experience coordinating planning processes, budgets, timelines and deliverables across multiple markets.
  • The confidence to review and challenge media plans, and translate strategic direction into practical requirements for local teams.
  • An understanding of how strategy, planning, investment, activation, data and measurement work together on an integrated media account.
  • A structured, hands-on approach—and the ability to create clarity and accountability across multiple teams.
  • Strong client, communication and presentation skills, with fluency in English.
  • A collaborative, curious and commercially minded approach to problem-solving.

What we offer

  • Flexible working: Enjoy hybrid working, flexible hours and the opportunity to work temporarily from another EU country.
  • Salary: €5,150 – €8,150 depending on your experience
  • Room to grow: Develop your skills in an innovative, dynamic team with a strong focus on AI transformation.
  • Learning and development: Access to M Academy for a wide range of hard- and soft-skills training, workshops and AI-focused courses.
  • Wellbeing: Get access to the Headspace app and a monthly €10 Epassi allowance to spend on personal wellbeing.
  • Time off: 26 days of annual leave, with the option to purchase up to 9 additional days, plus 8% holiday allowance.
  • Travel and hybrid-work support: Travel expenses fully reimbursed, plus a €30 net monthly hybrid-working allowance for full-time employees.
  • Phone allowance: A monthly BYOD allowance of €57.50 net.
  • Lunch and coffee: Affordable lunches in the staff canteen and freshly made coffee from our barista.
  • Healthcare: Access to our collective health insurance plan.

If you enjoy bringing people and plans together, creating order in complex environments and making media planning better across markets, we’d love to hear from you.

  • Solid experience in managing IT teams in setting up and managing complex environments in large-scale IT projects in a banking environment.
  • Experience in managing IT infrastructure, networking, virtualization, containerization, and cloud technologies.

  • Proficient in stakeholder communication and program leadership.
  • Experience working in ITIL-based, DevOps, or agile project environments.
  • High degree of ownership and structured work approach.
  • Ability to clearly communicate complex technical topics in both German and English.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical infrastructure expertise with proven experience in managing complex IT projects, leading technical teams, and coordinating stakeholders in large-scale enterprise environments.

This role requires a hands-on understanding of modern IT infrastructure, automation, and operational processes, alongside strong project leadership, communication, and organizational skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and coordinate a large-scale AI Ops implementation project, ensuring effective planning, execution, and alignment with business and technical objectives.
  • Manage and coordinate cross-functional IT teams responsible for setting up, integrating, and managing complex infrastructure environments.
  • Oversee infrastructure-related activities across networking, virtualization, containerization, and cloud technologies.
  • Ensure the implementation aligns with existing IT architecture, operational processes, and enterprise infrastructure standards.
  • Oversee the consideration of functional and non-functional requirements, including performance, security, availability, and operational stability.
  • Manage dependencies, technical risks, and implementation challenges across different teams and workstreams.
  • Act as a key interface between technical teams, project stakeholders, and management, ensuring transparent communication and alignment.
  • Drive collaboration in ITIL-based, DevOps, and agile delivery environments.
  • Establish structured project governance, track progress, and ensure timely delivery of key milestones.

Skills and Expertise

  • Solid experience in managing IT teams in setting up and managing complex environments in large-scale IT projects in a banking environment.
  • Experience in managing IT infrastructure, networking, virtualization, containerization, and cloud technologies.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies, and test automation.
  • Understanding of both functional and non-functional test requirements (e.g., performance, security, availability).
  • Proficient in stakeholder communication and program leadership.
  • Experience working in ITIL-based, DevOps, or agile project environments.
  • High degree of ownership and structured work approach.
  • Ability to clearly communicate complex technical topics in both German and English.

description: Du möchtest die Qualität von Bauprojekten sichern, Bauherren fachlich beraten und anspruchsvolle Hochbauprojekte im Großraum Lübeck begleiten? Dann suchen wir genau Dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als: Ingenieur:in Qualitätssicherung Wohnungsneubau (w/m/d) im Großraum Bremen | Vollzeit oder Teilzeit ab 32 Stunden pro Woche Als Mitarbeiter:in in der Qualitätssicherung im Bauwesen betreust Du eigenverantwortlich Bauprojekte unserer Auftraggeber im Bereich Hochbau. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Neubau und Sanierung von Wohnraum. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit den Projektleiter:innen der Bauherren zusammen und stehst ihnen beratend zur Seite. Die Stelle ist in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit ab 32 Stunden pro Woche zu besetzen. Die sigeko-Ingenieure GmbH ist seit über 25 Jahren erfolgreich am Markt tätig und verfügt über ein erfahrenes Team von 25 Mitarbeitenden. In dieser Zeit hat das Unternehmen bereits über 2.500 Projekte erfolgreich begleitet. Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Tätigkeit als Sicherheits- und Gesundheitsschutzkoordinator auf Baustellen. Deine Aufgaben: Qualitätssicherung auf der Baustelle Bauvorhaben im Bereich Qualitätssicherung betreust Du eigenverantwortlich und sorgst für die Einhaltung der vereinbarten Qualitätsstandards. Hochbauprojekte mit Schwerpunkt auf Neubau und Sanierung von Wohnraum begleitest Du während der relevanten Bauphasen. Regelmäßige Baustellenbegehungen führst Du eigenständig durch und überprüfst die Qualität der ausgeführten Arbeiten. Deine Begehungen und Prüfergebnisse dokumentierst Du strukturiert und nachvollziehbar. Prüfung & Beratung Relevante Projektunterlagen wie Leistungsverzeichnisse prüfst Du sorgfältig im Hinblick auf die Qualitätssicherung. Weitere qualitätsrelevante Unterlagen sichtest und bewertest Du im Rahmen Deiner Projektbetreuung. Die Projektleiter:innen der Bauherren berätst Du fachlich zu Fragen der Qualitätssicherung und möglichen Verbesserungsmaßnahmen. Projektspezifische Prüfergebnisse besprichst Du mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartner:innen und unterstützt bei der Abstimmung weiterer Schritte. Kunden- & Projektmanagement Mit den Projektleiter:innen der Bauherren stimmst Du Dich regelmäßig ab und sorgst für eine transparente Kommunikation. Die Zusammenarbeit mit den beteiligten Planer:innen koordinierst Du und stellst einen reibungslosen Informationsaustausch sicher. Mit ausführenden Unternehmen und weiteren Projektbeteiligten arbeitest Du eng zusammen und klärst offene Fragen zur Qualitätssicherung. Deine Projekte organisierst und steuerst Du eigenverantwortlich und behältst dabei Termine, Anforderungen und Qualitätsziele im Blick. Deine Startvoraussetzungen: Das bringst Du mit: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Architektur, Bauingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Fachbereich beziehungsweise eine Qualifikation als öffentlich bestellte:r und vereidigte:r oder zertifizierte:r Bausachverständige:r bildet Deine fachliche Grundlage. Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Qualitätssicherung, Bauleitung oder Bauüberwachung im Wohnungsneubau bringst Du mit. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau in Wort und Schrift ermöglichen Dir eine sichere Kommunikation mit allen Projektbeteiligten. Eine eigenverantwortliche und strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Kommunikationsstärke, sichere Microsoft-Office-Kenntnisse sowie die Bereitschaft zu regionalen Außendiensteinsätzen runden Dein Profil ab. Das hilft Dir, schneller erfolgreich zu sein: Erfahrung mit anspruchsvollen Hochbauprojekten wäre von Vorteil. Kenntnisse im Neubau und in der Sanierung von Wohnraum sind wünschenswert. Praktische Erfahrung in der Prüfung von Leistungsverzeichnissen und weiteren Projektunterlagen wäre ein Plus. Erfahrung in der Beratung von Bauherren und der Abstimmung mit unterschiedlichen Projektbeteiligten würde Dir den Einstieg erleichtern. Unsere Benefits: Attraktive Vergütung & Urlaub: Je nach Erfahrung liegt das Bruttojahresgehalt zwischen 65.000 und 75.000 Euro. Dich erwarten außerdem 30 Tage Jahresurlaub. Flexibles & familienfreundliches Arbeitsumfeld: Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag, keine Schichtarbeit sowie flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, mobil zu arbeiten. Mobilität & Zusatzleistungen: Fahrtkostenerstattung, Poolfahrzeug, JobRad und Deutschlandticket. Ein Dienstwagen ist bei Vollzeit möglich, auch zur privaten Nutzung; in diesem Fall reduziert sich das Jahresgehalt um etwa 10.000 Euro. Zusätzlich bieten wir eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Onboarding & moderne Ausstattung: Ein strukturiertes Onboarding begleitet Deinen Einstieg. Für Deine tägliche Arbeit erhältst Du ein Arbeits-Smartphone und einen Arbeitslaptop. Teamkultur & Weiterentwicklung: Dich erwartet ein kollegiales Team mit flachen Hierarchien sowie regelmäßige Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Außerdem bieten wir Dir eine zukunftssichere Beschäftigung in einem regional verwurzelten Dienstleistungsunternehmen. Unser Bewerbungsprozess: Kurzes Telefonat mit dem Talent-Acquisition-Team der Arsipa Gruppe. Interview mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartner:innen der sigeko-Ingenieure GmbH. Hospitation/persönliches Kennenlernen mit dem Team aus dem Fachbereich der sigeko-Ingenieure GmbH. Für weitere Fragen stehen wir Dir gerne jederzeit zur Verfügung! Du erreichst das Talent-Acquisition-Team der Arsipa Gruppe unter Werde Teil unserer spannenden Reise bei der sigeko-Ingenieure GmbH - Wir freuen uns auf Dich! Die sigeko-Ingenieure GmbH ist Teil der Arsipa Gruppe, einer schnell wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 90 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-and-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel ist es, eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt zu werden – unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, HR, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin. description: Who we are We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves. With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another. Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth. We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands. We’re on the search for... Someone who has built a community for a brand before, and who can bring ours to life online and offline. Since 1959, Interrail has been more than a rail pass. We’re now building it into a cultural movement, and our community is where that movement becomes real: the deeper you travel through Europe, the more the journey changes you, told by the people who lived it. In 2027 our community moves into the Interrail app and website. Our product and technical team builds the platform. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other. The Brand team shapes what Interrail stands for and how it shows up wherever travellers meet us. We own our brand platform and positioning, and our community, bringing The Interrail Effect to life through the people who’ve travelled with us. We work closely with Product, Social & Community, Creative & Content, CRM, and the PR & Partnerships teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and culturally sharp. This is a nine-month interim contract. The team meets in the office a minimum of twice per week, so you’ll be required to join those days to work alongside your colleagues. What you’ll be doing You’ll be part of the Brand team, reporting to the Brand Lead who owns the Community Program. You’ll lead the community from launch to a community that’s live, safe, well populated and growing, online and offline. The community isn’t a loyalty scheme or a fan club. It’s where travellers tell the truth about their journeys, inspire others and help the next person go and experience it. You’ll work closely with Product (Social Connection and Loyalty team), Customer Experience, Legal and Privacy, PR & Partnerships, Social, and our Creator Partnerships and Creative colleagues. You’ll be: Shaping the community vision, values and member code with the Brand Lead, and laying the foundations for Interrail as a cultural movement, online and offline. Building the community strategy: who we bring in first, which journeys launch first and how the community grows after launch. Bringing our existing members across as founding voices, and working with Content and Marketing to onboard our Pioneers. Launching the first community rituals, and making the community a source of real traveller stories for the brand. Designing and running a first pilot of real-world moments, such as gatherings at stations or partner places, with PR & Partnerships and Social. Building good relationships with the independent Interrail communities on Facebook, Reddit and beyond. We partner with them; we never try to replace them. Keeping the community safe: setting guidelines, the moderation approach with Customer Experience, and working with Legal, Privacy, and Safety so nothing goes live until it’s signed off. Being the members’ voice in our Product team, measuring community health with Analytics and CRM, and creating a playbook so what you build lasts. What we’re looking for Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you. 8+ years building communities for brands, including at least one you grew from launch. Experience running community both online and in real life, such as events, meet-ups or ambassador programs. You have written a community vision or strategy and turned it into a plan that others follow. A track record of building early momentum, so people join and champion the community, not just follow it. Experience setting moderation and safety policies, and comfort working with Legal and Privacy on consent, safeguarding and GDPR. A clear point of view on what makes a community healthy, and the confidence to defend it with product teams. Organised, good at documenting and comfortable working across many teams, so what you build outlasts your contract. A genuine interest in train travel, meeting locals, new experiences and other cultures. Bonus points for experience with community platforms or social SDKs, multilingual moderation, or a long rail trip through Europe of your own. Curious to apply? Apply directly through our careers page. We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through. For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice. If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you. To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential. In the meantime If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values? Got questions? Our team would be happy to help: just drop us a note at While you’re here, you can plan your own trip and find your Pass at www.interrail.com. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Our SDKs are downloaded 26M+ times per month, and for many developers the first thing they touch is an integration — a few lines of code that connect their favorite framework to Langfuse. When that experience is seamless, they’re wow’ed. When it’s not, we might have lost them. You’ll own that critical first impression across 40+ framework integrations. You’ll live at the frontier of LLM application development. The AI framework ecosystem moves fast — new agent frameworks, orchestration libraries, and model providers emerge every week. You’ll be among the first to instrument them, giving you unmatched exposure to how cutting-edge AI applications are built. The developers you serve are some of the most ambitious software engineers in the world, and working closely with them will make you an expert on LLM engineering yourself. Everything you build is open source and immediately visible. All Langfuse integrations are MIT-licensed. When you ship a new integration or improve an existing one, thousands of developers benefit the same day — and they’ll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on Twitter, and in our community channels. What You’ll Do Build and maintain framework integrations. Langfuse integrates with 40+ frameworks and model providers: OpenAI SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, OpenAI Agents, CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, LiveKit, and many more. You’ll own these integrations end-to-end — from initial implementation to ongoing maintenance as frameworks evolve. When a new framework gains traction, you’ll be among the first to instrument it. Design new integration patterns for emerging frameworks. When a framework or a new agent orchestrator appears, you’ll evaluate it, design the right instrumentation approach (callback handler, decorator, OTEL auto-instrumentation, or a combination), build the integration, write the docs, and ship it. You’ll develop strong opinions on what makes a great integration experience. Contribute to the core SDKs. While integrations are your primary focus, your work will surface needs in our Python and TypeScript SDKs. You’ll contribute improvements to the core SDK when your integration work demands it — whether that’s a new hook point, better context propagation, or performance optimizations. Write documentation and integration guides. At Langfuse, docs are part of our core product. When you ship a new integration, the guide ships with it. You’ll own the integration docs, quickstart tutorials, cookbooks, and migration paths that help developers get started in minutes. Be a voice in the developer community. You’ll engage with framework communities, respond to integration-related GitHub issues, write blog posts about new integrations, and be present in our Slack/Discord channels. You’ll build relationships with framework maintainers and represent Langfuse in the broader AI developer ecosystem. What We’re Looking For Passionate about the LLM ecosystem. You’ve built real applications with frameworks like LangChain, Pydantic AI, Vercel AI SDK, LlamaIndex, or similar — or you have a deep willingness to go deep and get your hands dirty with every major framework in the space. You’re excited about this ecosystem, not just familiar with it. Strong in Python and/or TypeScript. You write clean, reliable code. You don’t need to be a systems-level performance expert, but you care about code quality and understand that integrations run inside other people’s production systems. Product-minded engineer. You think about the developer who’s going to use your integration at 11pm trying to ship a feature. You obsess over the getting-started experience: how many lines of code does it take? Is the error message helpful? Does the docs example actually work? Self-directed and motivated. You know how to develop conviction about what to build and how to ship it. You don’t wait for detailed specs — you investigate the framework, talk to users, and propose the right approach. Excited about open source and developer community. You genuinely enjoy talking to developers about their integration challenges, writing clear documentation, and contributing to open source projects. Thrives in a small, accountable team. Your output is visible and matters. You’re comfortable owning outcomes, not just tasks. CS or quantitative degree preferred, but not required. We care far more about what you’ve built and your hunger to learn. Bonus Points Experience with OpenTelemetry internals or observability instrumentation Contributions to popular open source projects, SDKs, or developer tools Experience building developer tooling, CLIs, or client libraries Former founder or early startup experience Active presence in AI/ML developer communities (blog posts, talks, open source) No candidate checks all boxes. If you feel you are a good fit for this role, please go ahead and apply. Projects You Could Own Build and ship a Langfuse integration for an emerging agent framework (e.g., OpenClaw, new OTEL-based instrumentation) Design the integration pattern for a new category of AI tools (e.g., voice agents via LiveKit/Pipecat) Create comprehensive quickstart cookbooks that get developers from zero to traced in under 5 minutes Work with the OpenTelemetry community to improve GenAI semantic conventions Maintain and upgrade our most popular integrations (OpenAI, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK) as those frameworks ship breaking changes Perks Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity. Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites. Culture - We All Shape It As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture. Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse. description: We are looking for a hands-on macOS & Jamf Automation Engineer to engineer, automate and continuously improve the services that support our global Apple device estate. This role is focused on delivering a secure, reliable and consistent macOS experience at scale through Jamf Pro, reusable code, APIs and modern engineering practices. You will replace repetitive administration and one-off scripts with maintainable automation for device enrolment, configuration, application delivery, patching, compliance and lifecycle management. Working across Jamf Pro, Apple Business Manager, identity, security, asset and service-management platforms, you will build integrations and workflows that make Apple device services easier to operate, measure and support. Engineering mindset Automation is the product, not an afterthought. We are looking for someone who sees a manual Jamf task, fragile policy or recurring Mac support issue and asks, “How can we make this reliable, reusable and self-service?” You should be comfortable working from Apple and Jamf documentation, investigating unfamiliar behaviours and translating operational requirements into production-quality automation. Your solutions account for failure, test changes before release, scale to an enterprise environment, provide useful telemetry and favour reusable frameworks over isolated scripts. You take ownership from design through operation, document your work and balance long-term platform improvements with immediate business needs. What success looks like You will measurably reduce manual effort, deployment lead time and configuration drift across the macOS estate. Enrollment, configuration, software delivery, patching, security compliance and device lifecycle processes will become increasingly automated, observable, auditable and recoverable. Over time, you will establish a scalable Apple endpoint automation model based on Jamf Pro, APIs, version-controlled code, release pipelines and shared engineering standards rather than manual platform administration. What you'll do macOS Platform & Jamf Automation Design and maintain automation for macOS enrolment, provisioning, configuration, application delivery, updates and device retirement using Jamf Pro. Build reusable scripts, tools and workflows using shell scripting, Python, Jamf APIs and other appropriate technologies. Administer and automate Jamf policies, configuration profiles, Jamf Blueprints, Jamf compliance, extension attributes, smart groups, packages and lifecycle workflows. Integrate Jamf Pro and Apple Business Manager with identity, security, asset, infrastructure and service-management platforms. description:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our CFO Advisory practice are looking for an experienced Managers & Senior Managers to join the team. 

Our CFO Advisory capability blends technical accounting, finance and treasury knowledge consulting and industry experience to focus on our client’s most strategic priorities. Independent by design, we act as an impartial, critical friend to CFOs. We help our clients address challenges, and respond to opportunities around business integration, business performance, and climate and sustainability across all industry groups. 

What you will be doing

  • Finding business efficiencies and opportunities by reviewing operating models, technology and change strategies across finance and treasury, including: Operating Model Transformation, Technology, Data & ERP Strategy and People, Talent & Change

  • Enabling data based decisions so that Finance can add value and drive enterprise performance right across the organisation, including: Business Insights, Integrated Planning and Forecasting & Scenario Modelling

  • Helping embed sustainability into finance, respond to regulatory requirements, and anticipate and respond to consumer and investor sentiment, including: Investor Relations & Financing, Carbon Budgeting and Disclosures

  • At this time, we have a particular interest in candidates who are passionate about:

    • Technology-driven Finance and Treasury transformation

    • EPM processes and tools

    • End-to-end Finance process improvement and automation 

Your skills and experience

  • You will be a passionate and curious finance and treasury professional with a background in consultancy or experience in a project focused role within industry - FS and non FS clients are both of interest

  • You will need to have excellent relationship building and communication skills, and experience of working well in teams

  • You will need to have a strong understanding of finance and treasury transformation projects with project / programme experience across the full project lifecycle and the ability to take ownership, provide a point of view and deliver results in challenging, client-facing environment

  • You would benefit from having Tier 1 ERP experience, with knowledge of what good looks like 

What a career at Baringa will give you 

Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

Join us

All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. Please contact a member of our Recruitment Team to discuss further.

description: About Black Forest Labs We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We're creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started. Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity. Why this role FLUX models ship as open weights, which gives anyone full access to the model. Our safety efforts focus on suppressing harmful behaviors and mitigating the risk of misuse, so safety has to be built into the models themselves, not bolted on afterwards. As a Member of Technical Staff on our safety research team, you'll research and ship methods that make FLUX models safe by design: from what goes into the training data to how the models are mid- and post-trained, across images, video and the text that conditions them. This is a role with real ownership: you won't just do research on model safety, you'll shape it. The methods you build ship in FLUX models with over 75 million downloads on Hugging Face and in production at some of the largest platforms in the world. What you'll work on Develop mid- and post-training safety methods for FLUX models, such as safety SFT, preference optimization and RL with safety rewards, and concept erasure. Build safety data filtering that runs at pretraining scale: classifiers and pipelines that screen billions of images, video clips and captions, with measured Pareto frontiers and precision/recall trade-offs. Make safety hold up for open-weight releases, including robustness to adversarial prompts and to downstream fine-tuning. Extend safety to the text side of the stack: prompts, captions and the text encoders that condition our models. Design evaluations and red-teaming that measure harmful generations alongside image quality and prompt following, so safety gains don't come at the cost of performance. Work directly with pretraining and post-training teams so your methods land in the release model, and publish where it makes sense. What we're looking for Hands-on research experience in visual safety: safety of text-to-image, text-to-video or vision-language models, such as harm classifiers, safe generation methods or safety benchmarks. Proven experience in at least one of: Large-scale safety data filtering: building and running classifiers or filtering pipelines over hundreds of millions of samples or more. Safety mid- or post-training: safety SFT, DPO or RL with safety objectives, or unlearning applied to large generative models. Deep familiarity with concept erasure methods (e.g. ESD, UCE, adversarial unlearning) and their failure modes, such as concept recovery and collateral damage to unrelated concepts. Track record of shipping: top-venue publications (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV) paired with production impact, or unambiguous production wins at a frontier lab. Experience with distributed training at multi-node scale. Strong PyTorch fluency; you write research code that others can build on. You work fluently with coding agents to move faster, and have the depth to verify their output and own the result. Experience running multi-agent workflows: you know which tasks to hand off and which to keep yourself, and you use the speed-up to raise the quality bar, not lower it. We'd be especially excited if you: Know how to keep safety intact after release, when others fine-tune open weights. Have tackled safety for video generation, where harm can emerge across frames rather than in any single frame. Bring experience with audio safety, especially for jointly generated audio and video, where each modality can amplify harm in the other. Have unlearned concepts from text encoders or built safety-tuned encoders (e.g. Safe-CLIP-style approaches). Have worked on text safety: LLM safety tuning, prompt and jailbreak defenses, or text safety classifiers, ideally across languages. Have applied latent-space safety methods, such as activation steering or safe guidance. Have built VLM-based safety judges or guard models for filtering or evaluation. How we work together We're a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. You'll join us in Freiburg at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week). We'll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we've structured things to make it accessible to all. We'll discuss what this will look like for the role during our interview process. Everything we do is grounded in four values: Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful. Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task. Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect. Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.
