description: Jouw impact bij Movares Jouw advies voorkomt dat hoogspanningsverbindingen risico’s voor de omgeving veroorzaken. Zo maak jij de uitbreiding van het Nederlandse energienet veilig en verantwoord mogelijk. Dit ga je doen bij Movares Je adviseert toonaangevende opdrachtgevers over complexe elektromagnetische beïnvloeding rond hoogspanningsverbindingen. Je vertaalt normen en technische analyses naar heldere scenario’s, risico’s en praktisch uitvoerbare maatregelen. Je krijgt de ruimte om jouw expertise zichtbaar in te zetten, bijvoorbeeld bij klanten en binnen normcommissies. Als senior adviseur EMC overzie je complexe vraagstukken rond elektromagnetische beïnvloeding. Je beoordeelt welke normen van toepassing zijn, doorziet vroegtijdig de gevolgen voor assets van derden en adviseert over passende maatregelen. Je kijkt verder dan afzonderlijke berekeningen, waarbij je project overstijgende risico’s signaleert, de scope afbakent en klanten helpt weloverwogen keuzes te maken. Je werkt voor onder meer netbeheerders, infrabeheerders en eigenaren van kabels en leidingen. Dit ben jij bij Movares Je combineert diepgaande technische kennis met overtuigende adviesvaardigheden. Je bent klantgericht, pragmatisch en oplossingsgericht en weet complexe normering begrijpelijk uit te leggen zonder de technische nauwkeurigheid te verliezen. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je projecten, zoekt actief de samenwerking op en durft richting te geven aan klanten en collega’s. Dit breng je ook mee: een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in elektrotechniek, technische natuurkunde of een vergelijkbare technische richting; ruime relevante werkervaring, bij voorkeur circa tien jaar, met EMC, elektromagnetische beïnvloeding, hoogspanningssystemen of een aanverwant specialistisch vakgebied; ervaring met technisch advies, projectmatig werken en het vertalen van normen en onderzoeksresultaten naar concrete maatregelen; ervaring met GIS applicaties en programmeren in MATLAB of Python is een pré; kennis van de NEN3654:2023 en RLN00398 is een pré. Dit krijg je bij Movares Bij Movares werk je aan opgaven die Nederland verder helpen. Tegelijk krijg je de ruimte om je werk en loopbaan in te richten op een manier die bij jou past. Met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, veel flexibiliteit en volop mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen. Een sterk fundament Een goede basis begint bij voorwaarden waarop je kunt rekenen: een salaris tussen €6.250 en €7.250 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur; een flexibele pot van minimaal 15% van je jaarsalaris, inclusief vakantiegeld; een goede pensioenregeling bij Zwitserleven, waarbij Movares twee derde van de pensioenpremie betaalt; een NS Business Card voor woon-werkverkeer en zakelijke reizen. Privé profiteer je met de kaart van de dalurenkorting. Maximaal flexibel Vorm een manier van werken die aansluit bij jouw leven én jouw ambities. Maak keuzes die bij jou passen: flexibel werken volgens ons Any Time Any Place-principe, passend bij je team, klanten en projecten; de mogelijkheid om twee weken per jaar te werken vanaf je vakantieadres binnen de EU; 20 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen te kopen vanuit je flexibele pot; met je flexibele pot kies je wat voor jou belangrijk is, bijvoorbeeld voor extra inkomen, pensioen, een fiets, bedrijfsfitness, verduurzaming van je woning of het aflossen van je studieschuld; € 750 budget per vijf jaar om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten; € 2,45 netto thuiswerkvergoeding per thuiswerkdag. Veel ontwikkelmogelijkheden Ontwikkel een loopbaan die past bij jouw talenten en ambities. Kies jouw eigen pad: ruimte om je expertise, ambitie en loopbaan verder te ontwikkelen; leren door te doen, samen met ervaren collega's en met gebruik van een breed aanbod aan ontwikkelmogelijkheden; de kans om actief kennis te delen en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van ons vakgebied. Samen groeien Deel mee in de waarde die we samen creëren en de groei van onze organisatie. Samen voor succes: je flexibele pot groeit mee met de resultaten van Movares; een winstdeling met een doelbedrag van 5% van je bruto jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van de resultaten; en de mogelijkheid tot participeren in de waardeontwikkeling van Movares door middel van aankoop van phantom aandelen. Jouw team bij Movares De afdeling Energie is een gezellige en sociale club van ongeveer 50 collega’s. Regelmatig organiseren we gezellige teamuitjes, organiseren we uitdagende kennissessies en zijn we aanwezig op leerzame events! Als onderdeel van team Energie sta je midden in de energietransitie. Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Mirakl Assistant team, led by Remi Takase, Senior Data Science Manager. The team is part of a passionate and skilled data organisation of Data Scientists, Research Scientists, Data Engineers and SREs, building on a state-of-the-art Machine Learning and Data platform. The Mirakl Assistant team is a new team that runs like a start-up inside a scale-up. Together, you'll be designing, building and scaling the conversational AI assistant that changes how our users work across Mirakl products.

The assistant knows the platform and the users, and helps them get the most out of Mirakl, from finding their way around the product, to understanding their business and growing it. We're taking it from conversational to action-oriented: users ask, and the assistant gets it done.

AI agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software: what customers expect from it, how they interact with it, and how they integrate it into their business. At Mirakl, AI is a core part of our product strategy - from Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce. This is where you come in.

The position is a freelance contract, based in Paris or Bordeaux, with up to 1 day of remote work per week. 

2. Your Impact

  • Design, build and scale the core capabilities of the Mirakl Assistant, including RAG, LLM orchestration, tool use, memory and context engineering, from rapid prototype to robust production feature
  • Own the full production lifecycle of the assistant: automated data pipelines, CI/CD, deployment, load testing, latency and resilience
  • Run technical discovery and feasibility studies for new capabilities and integrations across Mirakl products
  • Drive quality improvement through rigorous offline and online evaluation, data-driven experimentation and iteration
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Software, Data Engineering, SRE and Product teams to evolve the agentic foundations and translate user needs into capabilities

Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer with strong software engineering skills, or as a Software/Data Engineer with hands-on AI and ML experience
  • Proven track record of deploying AI/ML systems in production products, with an automation-first approach
  • Proven experience building AI agents with LLMs, RAG, MCP and related technologies, including architectural design
  • Strong experience in data-driven iteration, from experimentation to evaluation

Skills:

  • LLM orchestration and agentic systems design (RAG, MCP, LangChain, etc.)
  • Software engineering proficiency in Python
  • Solid grounding in machine learning algorithms and fundamental
  • Rigorous metrics-driven evaluation and experimentation
  • A "0 to 1" mindset: able to thrive in ambiguity and take an idea from exploration to production
  • Product sense: understanding end users’ pain points and balancing technical excellence with customer impact 
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
  • Frontend development (TypeScript, React) is a plus

4. Tech Stack

  • Languages: Python, SQL, TypeScript
  • Backend: FastAPI, LangChain, OpenSearch, Kafka, PostgreSQL
  • Frontend: React (micro-frontend architecture)
  • AI: LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)
  • Data Platform & Orchestration: Spark, Delta Lake, Databricks Workflows
  • Observability: Langfuse, MLflow

title: (Senior) Consultant* - Murex/Capital Markets (m/w/d)

description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

Our global Legal team has built a strong reputation within the company for our highly collaborative and supportive approach to counseling, always with a bias for action. We are a diverse group of lawyers and legal professionals with a shared passion for providing creative, best-in-class service to our business partners. The Competition & Litigation team advises DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo on antitrust, competition, and litigation matters across every market we operate in.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Counsel, Competition & Litigation to join our growing Legal team and work globally across the DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo brands. Reporting to the Director, Competition & Litigation, you’ll be a generalist antitrust attorney who can move fast: advising product and business teams in real time, supporting M&A and strategic investments alongside our Corporate Development team, and driving forward regulatory investigations and inquiries, with a particular focus on Europe. This is a hybrid role that will require you to work from our London HQ or Brussels office for a minimum of 3 days a week. 

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Serve as a trusted antitrust/competition advisor to product, business, and corporate development teams, delivering fast, practical counsel that lets the business move with velocity while properly managing risk.
  • Advise on the competition and antitrust dimensions of M&A transactions, strategic investments, and commercial partnerships, partnering closely with Corporate Development and our sales teams.
  • Manage antitrust and competition regulatory investigations and inquiries globally.
  • Help build out DoorDash’s international competition compliance program, partnering with the Director, Competition & Litigation on training, policies, and processes across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo.
  • Support competition-related litigation matters as needed, including document collection and review, witness preparation, and responses to third-party subpoenas.
  • Partner with policy and government relations teams to track legal and regulatory developments that could affect the business.

We’re excited about you because…

  • You are a qualified solicitor in England & Wales (or bring similar qualifications in another European jurisdiction) with significant experience providing strategic legal advice to international businesses.
  • You have 7+ years of experience at a leading law firm and/or in-house legal department, with a strong grounding in antitrust/competition law as a generalist — spanning M&A counseling, litigation, and regulatory/government investigations.
  • You have experience advising on competition issues in mergers, acquisitions, and strategic investments, including regulatory filings and clearance strategy.
  • You have experience handling antitrust/competition regulatory inquiries or investigations, ideally including direct engagement with regulators such as the European Commission, UK CMA, DOJ, FTC, or other competition authorities.
  • You’re comfortable operating as a generalist across a broad portfolio — you don’t need deep pre-existing expertise in every sub-area, but you can quickly get up to speed and give practical, business-minded advice.
  • You’re an excellent product counselor: able to translate complex antitrust concepts into clear, fast, actionable guidance for product and business teams.
  • You’re comfortable working across multiple jurisdictions and legal systems, and can navigate the added complexity of advising across three global brands (DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo).
  • You have strong organizational skills and can juggle multiple concurrent workstreams in a fast-moving environment, both independently and as part of a team.
  • You’re an outstanding communicator, both orally and in writing, with sound judgment on when to escalate and when to move forward independently.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Partner closely with business stakeholders with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Learn something new everyday Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine. Our interview process typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

Vinted’s Marketing domain is growing - we’re on a mission to make Vinted known and loved as the go-to destination for everything second-hand. Marketing is one of the primary drivers behind our biggest strategic goals, from winning the USA market to expanding beyond fashion into a multi-vertical platform.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Marketing Data Science and Analytics team to hands-on build, refine, and scale our core predictive and explanatory models. In this role, you will be the technical engine behind our Bayesian Media Mix Models (MMM), user value machine learning models, and advanced statistical frameworks. Your focus will be on engineering robust, high-performing models that transform complex data into the precise insights our domain relies on.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Evolve Our Marketing Measurement: Code, calibrate, and scale our Bayesian Media Mix Models (MMM) and ROI frameworks to unlock precise business insights.
  • Build and Deploy Core Models: Build and maintain sophisticated econometric and statistical models (MMM, GMV, engagement) to quantify marketing impact and guide multi-channel growth.
  • Automate Model Validation & Health Monitoring: Design automated frameworks and reliability metrics that continuously monitor model health and ensure long-term accuracy.
  • Build Next-Gen, Automated Capabilities: Drive the ambition toward intelligent data products [such as self-healing MMMs] using modern AI and automation to optimize model runtimes and scale our ecosystem as Vinted grows.
  • Partner with Decision Scientists & Marketing Leadership: Act as the core technical partner, translating complex mechanics into clear concepts and helping the team connect model outputs to robust business decisions.
  • Champion Modelling Excellence: Maintain a high bar for code quality, rigorous validation, and reproducibility to ensure our data science practices remain clean and trusted.

About you 

  • Proven Data Science Experience: Hands-on experience focused on advanced statistical, econometric, or time-series modelling (experience in marketing measurement/MMM is an advantage).
  • Deep Theoretical Knowledge: Strong foundation in advanced statistics, causal inference, and regression. Familiarity with probabilistic programming (e.g., PyMC) is a major plus.
  • Research-to-Application Mindset: Ability to read scientific papers, explore state-of-the-art techniques, and replicate or adapt advanced methodologies to solve complex problems.
  • Production-Grade Engineering: Highly proficient in Python, with a passion for building models as data products. You design your pipelines and code so they are modular, reproducible, and easily used or extended by other scientists.
  • Business-Minded Tech Partner: You care deeply about the why behind your code, naturally connecting technical model outputs to commercial metrics and business outcomes.
  • Educational Background: A Master’s or PhD degree in a highly quantitative discipline (Statistics, Econometrics, Mathematics, Data Science, or similar).
  • Impactful storyteller: A charismatic and confident presenter who navigates any topic’s technicality, actively driving and facilitating strategic business conversations across both technical and leadership audiences.

description: Why Coda Coda is a global growth engine for commerce, connecting people, digital products, and payments through trusted monetization and distribution solutions. With 600+ people from 57 nationalities across 23 locations, we’re a truly global team headquartered in Singapore, with offices in Amsterdam, Dubai, Bristol, Shanghai, Eindhoven, and across Southeast Asia. We power global commerce through a dual model. Our B2B solutions, Codapay, Coda Webstore, Coda Links, Coda Distribution, and Giftcloud, enable publishers and brands to monetize and distribute digital content globally. On the consumer side, we operate a portfolio of trusted storefronts including Codashop, Recharge.com, Startselect.com, and mobiletopup.co.uk, that give customers secure and easy access to game top-ups, digital credits, vouchers, gift cards and prepaid products in over 70 markets. Our culture is built on respect, ownership, and collaboration. We move fast, support each other, and celebrate wins together. If you’re looking to grow your career and make a real impact in a global team, Coda is the place for you. The Opportunity As Senior Financial Analyst at Coda, you'll play a key role in shaping how we plan, forecast, and steer our financial performance. You'll coordinate our budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning cycles, bringing together our B2B and B2C businesses into one clear financial outlook. You'll also take ownership of our planning and reporting processes in Aleph and manage the group's non-personnel fixed operating expenses. Reporting to the Director of FP&A, this is a hands-on role with high visibility and real impact. Your work will directly inform decisions made by our CFO, executive team, and Board, giving you the opportunity to influence how Coda plans for the future. What You'll Do Planning: Own the annual budget, regular forecasts and long-term financial planning process across the Group. Consolidation: Integrate B2B and B2C forecasts into a comprehensive Group P&L, balance sheet and cash flow outlook. Quality: Own key financial assumptions, challenge business drivers and ensure consistency, accuracy and reliability across forecasts. Strategic Insights: Develop financial scenarios, sensitivity analyses and product profitability insights to support executive decision-making. Ownership: Lead the development of our financial planning platform, streamlining forecasting, consolidations and reporting into one efficient process. Automation and AI: Identify and implement smarter ways of working to improve efficiency, accuracy and scalability across FP&A. Budgeting: Own the budget for non-personnel operating expenses, set cost centre targets and oversee approvals for unbudgeted spending. Reporting: Prepare and review high-quality financial analyses, Board materials, investor updates and lender reporting, including covenant calculations. Partner: Work closely with the Director FP&A and step in to lead planning and reporting cycles when required. Collaboration: Partner with Accounting, Treasury and Business Control teams across Amsterdam, Singapore and Jakarta to drive alignment and financial performance. What You'll Bring FP&A expertise: 6-8 years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance or a related field, including at least 3 years leading budgeting and forecasting cycles. Planning & consolidation: Proven experience managing and consolidating forecasts across multiple entities, markets or business units. Financial modelling: Strong three-statement modelling skills and a solid understanding of cash flow and working capital. Systems & analytical skills: Advanced Excel or Google Sheets proficiency and hands-on experience with planning tools such as Aleph, Anaplan, Adaptive, Pigment or similar. Stakeholder management: Confidence to collaborate with, influence and constructively challenge senior stakeholders across finance and the wider business. Communication & education: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills and a degree in finance, economics, econometrics or a related field. Business environment: Experience in a high-growth, international or investor-backed organisation is a strong advantage. Strategic finance exposure: Familiarity with Board, investor or lender reporting, including financial covenants. A background in Big 4, transaction services or investment banking is a plus. Process improvement & innovation: A track record of building scalable finance processes, implementing or improving planning systems, or leveraging AI tools to drive efficiency is highly valued. Mindset & ownership: Structured, pragmatic and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership, the ability to deliver under pressure and confidence working across international teams and time zones. Our goal is to foster an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome and valued. If you don't hear from us, rest assured there may be another opportunity at Coda that aligns better with your unique abilities. Remember to check our Careers Page for more exciting job openings! With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

As a Senior Manager in our Commodities & Energy Trading practice, you will help clients navigate changing commodity markets by combining trading expertise with the practical application of data, analytics and AI.

You will play a key role in shaping and delivering our commodity and energy trading proposition: leading client engagements, developing new opportunities and showing clients where AI and advanced analytics can create genuine commercial value.

You are likely to bring deep expertise in either commodities and energy trading or data, analytics and AI, together with some understanding or practical exposure to the other. You will work alongside specialists from both disciplines, building on your core expertise while continuing to deepen your capabilities across the intersection of trading and AI. The aim is to turn emerging AI capabilities into practical, measurable improvements in how trading businesses operate.

  • Shape propositions at the intersection of commodity trading, AI and digital transformation, and bring market insight on how AI is changing trading organisations, business models and competitive dynamics
  • Translate real trading problems into practical GenAI and agentic use cases that deliver value to clients
  • Advise clients on where AI should augment human decision-making, where workflows can be automated, and where human judgement remains critical
  • Design trading journeys from opportunity identification and experimentation through to scaled adoption, with the metrics and value cases that show impact on performance, productivity, risk and profitability
  • Work with traders, portfolio managers, data scientists and technology teams to turn concepts into solutions that operate in live trading environments
  • Drive adoption of GenAI copilots, agents and intelligent workflows that improve trader productivity and decision quality
  • Establish governance, model risk, human oversight and responsible-use approaches without losing sight of commercial outcomes

Commodities & Energy Trading

  • Advise on front-to-back trading processes, from market intelligence and trade origination through execution, scheduling, settlement and risk management across commodities including Power, Oil & Refined Products, Natural Gas, LNG, Metals, Renewables and Environmental Products
  • Support clients in evolving their trading strategies, operating models and capabilities in response to changing markets and new technologies
  • Bring an understanding of market structure, pricing, forecasting, physical flows and the commercial decisions that drive trading performance

Your skills and experience 
 

We are looking for an experienced professional with 8-12+ years of relevant experience and a strong background in either commodities and energy trading or data, analytics and AI. The strongest candidates will combine meaningful experience across both areas. However, we also welcome applicants who bring deep expertise in one discipline alongside a working understanding of, or some practical exposure to, the other.

You might be a commodities and trading specialist who has applied data, analytics or AI to trading decisions, processes or transformation, or a data and AI practitioner who has worked in, or gained exposure to, commodities, energy or another trading environment.

You do not need equal depth in both disciplines, but you should be able to demonstrate a genuine foundation in each and a clear motivation to deepen your experience at their intersection.

  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to engage credibly with senior trading and executive stakeholders
  • The ability to distinguish genuinely valuable AI opportunities from technology-led experimentation
  • Experience contributing to or leading complex transformation, strategy or operating-model engagements
  • Strong leadership, communication and team-development skills
  • Deep expertise in either commodities and energy trading or data, analytics and AI, together with a working understanding of, or some practical exposure to, the other discipline and the commitment to continue building depth across both

If your primary background is in commodities and trading, you will ideally bring

  • Deep expertise in at least one commodity, such as Power, Gas, LNG, Oil, Metals or Environmental Products
  • A strong understanding of trading, portfolio management, risk, physical flows, scheduling, optimisation and/or commercial operations
  • Familiarity with ETRM/CTRM platforms and the wider trading technology and data ecosystems
  • Some experience of using, sponsoring or shaping data, analytics, automation or AI initiatives within a trading or commercial environment, together with an understanding of how these capabilities can improve trading decisions, processes and outcomes

If your primary background is in data, analytics and AI, you will ideally bring

  • Practical experience identifying, shaping or delivering AI, GenAI, machine learning or intelligent automation use cases
  • An understanding of the opportunities and limitations of GenAI, LLMs, AI agents and decision-support tools, and how they apply in a trading environment

HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Manager of Global Communications

The Senior Manager of Global Communications will lead Quince's media strategy and external storytelling as the company enters its next stage of growth. This is a rare build: the sole owner of the communications function, reporting directly to the Head of Brand Strategy & Narrative, with the mandate to shape how the market understands Quince's manufacturer-to-consumer model. The ideal candidate is a proven media operator with 8+ years of experience and genuine, current UK journalist relationships — someone who can translate complex operational ideas into stories that build trust over time, not just generate coverage.

Responsibilities

  • Own and execute Quince's UK communications strategy, building brand reputation and relevance as we scale in the market
  • Own UK media relationships, building deep ties across national, consumer, fashion, lifestyle, retail, business, and tech press
  • Drive a steady stream of proactive earned media, with culturally relevant UK story angles rather than imported US messaging
  • Lead communications around key UK moments (launches, campaigns, milestones), spotting opportunities beyond the announcement itself
  • Stay plugged into UK cultural and media conversations, and act as an early-warning system for reputation risk
  • Write and edit at an exceptional standard across pitches, press materials, and executive briefings, and prepare spokespeople for UK media
  • Partner closely with Brand, Social, Growth, Merchandising, and Creative to build communications into launches from the start, and manage UK agency partners
  • Build rigorous earned-media measurement (coverage quality, sentiment, share of voice) and the systems/playbooks to scale UK comms over time

Qualifications

Required:

  • 8+ years of experience in communications, public relations or media strategy, with significant experience working in the UK market
  • Deep, current relationships across UK national, consumer, fashion, lifestyle, retail and/or business media, and a strong understanding of how the UK media ecosystem actually works
  • Experience building the reputation of a consumer brand, retailer or high-growth company; experience supporting a new market entrant or rapidly scaling brand is a plus
  • Excellent editorial judgment and a strong instinct for what constitutes a genuinely compelling UK story
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to move comfortably between consumer storytelling, corporate narratives and sensitive reputation communications
  • Strong understanding of UK culture, consumer sentiment and the nuances that distinguish UK communications from US communications
  • Experience managing PR agencies and working effectively across global and cross-functional teams
  • Ability to translate complex business models and company narratives into simple, credible and culturally relevant stories
  • Comfortable operating with significant autonomy in a fast-moving, high-growth environment
  • Highly proactive, culturally curious and naturally plugged into what people are reading, talking about and paying attention to

 

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

A management consulting background is a plus. A track record in sales planning: quota and target setting, territory and book-of-business design, and forecasting cadences for a multi-market sales organisation. Hands-on with data and systems. You are comfortable with SQL and BI tools (e.g. Looker, Tableau) and have worked deeply in a CRM such as Salesforce. You build things yourself rather than only writing specs. Experience designing incentive models, variable pay structures, SPIFFs and performance tracking across commercial teams. A builder and generalist who is comfortable with ambiguity, can take a broad mandate and turn it into concrete outputs, and doesn't need a fully built stack to deliver. A clear communicator and trusted partner to senior leaders, able to translate data into a commercial narrative and build alignment across Sales, Finance and Product. Strong understanding of distinct sales motions, including Enterprise Sales, SMB Sales and Account Management. Experience with multi-product or platform sales is a plus. Bonus: experience using AI and automation to scale commercial operations. Why join us You will do work that matters and help build one of DoorDash's next big bets. Working here, you can expect to: Make a visible impact every day, directly improving how merchants run and grow their business. Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment, with autonomy, pace and real responsibility. Build a career, not just a role, as DashOS grows across EMEA. Deliver together in an inclusive, diverse and values-driven culture, with big hearts and small egos. Next steps If you are excited about building a new business from an early stage and taking real ownership, click below to apply, add your CV and get the conversation going! We review applications on an ongoing basis. 💙 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. description:
Senior Mechatronic System Architect | Medical Robotics (m/f/d)

Location: Maastricht, Aachen, and Eindhoven region, working mainly on-site with our development partner in Maastricht. Regular travel to Hamburg and to clinical sites, about 2 to 4 days per month.

Reports to: CTO

About the venture: ROB'E

ROB'E is a Hamburg-based medtech startup and part of the NLC Health Ventures portfolio. We are developing a robotic system that holds and steers a standard transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) probe during structural heart interventions. Interventionalists get stable, reproducible echo views, and echocardiographers no longer have to stand next to the patient in the X-ray field.

Our first-generation prototype has been used in a first-in-human study with published results. We are now developing the next generation from scratch as a fully compliant medical device for CE marking and FDA clearance. The team includes a CTO, a System Software Architect and a Head of Quality & Regulatory.

The role

You are the mechatronic design authority of ROB'E. You own the system architecture, the hardware requirements and the technical decisions for the mechanics, drives, sensing and electronics of our robot. You work on site with our engineering development partner in the Maastricht area and steer their team on our behalf. This is a hands-on senior role: you design yourself, review the work of others and make sure the hardware is safe, verifiable and ready for design transfer.

Responsibilities

  • Define and own the mechatronic system architecture: robotic device, drives, force and torque sensing, real-time controllers, safety supervisor, power supply and the interface to commercial TEE probes.
  • Translate user and system requirements into subsystem and interface specifications and keep them traceable through verification.
  • Act as technical counterpart to our engineering development partner, from ideation, technology and part selection through design reviews and approval of design outputs. Challenge cost and effort and make the make-or-buy call per subsystem.
  • Work closely with the System Software Architect on the hardware/software split, real-time control, and safety architecture.
  • Drive the hardware contribution to risk management (ISO 14971), including design FMEA and risk control measures.
  • Plan and lead hardware verification, pre-compliance and full compliance testing for electrical safety and EMC (IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2) with external test houses.
  • Contribute hardware documentation to the design history file and technical documentation under our ISO 13485 quality system.
  • Build prototypes for verification, usability studies and clinical evaluation, together with suppliers and the development partner.
  • Design for cost and manufacturability from the start and prepare the transfer to series production.

What you bring

Must have

  • MSc or PhD in mechatronics, mechanical, electrical or systems engineering.
  • At least 8 years of hardware development experience, including at least 3 years as a system architect or lead engineer.
  • Hands-on development of active medical devices through design controls, from concept to verified design.
  • Practical experience with IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2 and ISO 14971, and working knowledge of ISO 13485 and MDR.
  • Strong background in motion systems: drives, transmissions, encoders, force/torque sensing and motion safety.
  • Experience steering external engineering partners or suppliers, including technical reviews and cost control.
  • Fluent in English and comfortable working in a small, fast moving startup team.

Nice to have

  • Experience with medical robotics, catheter or endoscope handling, or image guided intervention systems.
  • Knowledge of cleanable and reprocessable device design and single use interface components.
  • Dutch or German language skills.

What we offer

  • A key role in a clinically validated medtech venture, with real influence on the product and the company.
  • Close collaboration with interventional cardiologists and direct exposure to the cath lab.
  • Permanent employment with a competitive salary and an employee stock option plan.
  • A lean, senior team with short decision paths.

Why Join ROB’E?

  • Build a category-defining MedTech company from an early stage
  • Work directly with experienced physician-founders
  • Take ownership across strategy, product, and company building
We would love to hear from exceptional individuals who are excited about building a company at the intersection of AI, robotics, and cardiovascular medicine.

description:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

You would own Mews' relationships with the press, turning company news, product launches and leadership insight into credible coverage across hospitality, travel, technology and business media. This is a new role, the first dedicated media relations seat at Mews, so the contacts you build and the way you work will set the standard for how we deal with the press. Hospitality technology offers good stories and unusual data to pitch, and leaders here respond to press requests within about a day.

You would join the Communications team within Marketing and work closely with the communications lead, the colleagues who shape our stories, and leadership, product marketing and regional marketing. Day to day you would pitch journalists directly, host press briefings, handle inbound enquiries and prepare leaders to speak well in front of the press. The role is remote first in Europe, ideally near London, Berlin or Paris where many of the journalists we work with are based, with about 10% travel to meet press and attend events such as Unfold.

Journalists respond to people they know and trust, not to mass pitches, and the strongest coverage comes from a specialist who holds those relationships personally. Mews has strong stories and data to offer, and this role exists so that someone owns that conversation: choosing the right journalist for each story, answering inbound questions quickly and accurately, and knowing when to escalate something sensitive. Done well, it builds the company's reputation with the people who cover our industry over the long term.

What you would do

  • Build and maintain direct relationships with journalists across hospitality, travel, technology and business media: develop stories with the communications team, pitch them proactively by phone and email, host press briefings and invite journalists to events such as Unfold.
  • Respond to inbound press enquiries (currently two to three a week and growing) quickly and accurately, and escalate anything potentially sensitive to the communications lead straight away.
  • Brief and coach executive and local spokespeople, and share what you learn from journalists with leadership.
  • Redesign how media monitoring, journalist research and coverage reporting work using AI, and set the workflows up so the rest of the team can use them.
  • Own and improve the team's media management tool, and check every AI-assisted pitch, briefing or summary before it reaches a journalist.

AI Fluency Level 3: in this role that means you have gone well beyond using AI to draft copy. You have redesigned parts of how media relations work gets done, such as monitoring, journalist research or coverage reporting, you have built approaches that colleagues now follow, and you actively question and check what AI gives you, including target lists, summaries and quotes, before anything reaches a journalist or a spokesperson.

For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates on Confluence.

What you would bring

  • Seven to ten years in PR and communications with depth in B2B media relations, including time in a PR agency.
  • Your own journalist contacts and hands-on experience pitching by phone, email and in person, with fully fluent English, written and spoken.
  • A record of handling reactive and sensitive press enquiries under time pressure, with clear habits about when to escalate.
  • Confidence preparing senior and non-expert spokespeople for press conversations.
  • AI Fluency Level 3 or the equivalent hands-on experience, shown through tools or workflows you have built for media relations work, not only content you have written with AI.

Nice to have

  • French or German alongside fluent English, or existing relationships with journalists in the UK, France, Germany or the US.
  • Experience with B2B technology clients or in hospitality.
  • Experience measuring coverage and coordinating local expertise in markets where you have fewer contacts.

Pay Transparency at Mews

Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.

This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.

If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.

What’s in it for you?

Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.

Global benefits

No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:

  • Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
  • Participation in our company share program
  • Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)
  • An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development
  • Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself
  • A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year
  • Relocation options, available after one year
  • Flexible, hybrid working options
  • A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance
  • Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working

Local benefits

You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.

Life at Mews

We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.

We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

A few things that define how we work:

  • High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.
  • Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.
  • We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.
  • AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.

If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.

We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.

One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.

If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.

description: Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place! E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems. We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life. Overview We are expanding our optomechanical capabilities, and the success of our projects depends on optical designs that are precise, manufacturable, and verified through rigorous analysis and testing. As a Senior Optical Design Engineer, you will own optical designs from concept through lab validation, turning requirements into lens designs and optical assemblies that perform reliably in the real world. This position is central to our mission of delivering cutting-edge free-space optical systems for space applications, and it will support successful pre-production runs and strong collaboration with our suppliers. This position reports to our Responsible Engineer, Optical Systems, and is based in our Toulouse, France office. Our working language is English. What you will be doing Design and optimize lenses and optical systems, from first-order layout to detailed optimization with ray tracing and physical optics propagation (POP). Carry out tolerance analysis and Monte Carlo simulations to predict manufacturing and assembly yield, and define realistic tolerances with suppliers. Conduct STOP (Structural-Thermal-Optical Performance) analysis with mechanical engineers, verifying performance and margins across operating conditions. Conduct stray light analysis. Produce lens and optomechanical drawings, and work with mechanical engineers to ensure designs are manufacturable and assemblable. Define assembly, alignment, and bonding procedures, and support their implementation in clean room environments. description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, installer, updater, device APIs, and enterprise DLP support. 

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. The role will lean on your Windows expertise, but projects may have a cross-platform component. This role will include development of features for Firefox in enterprise environments especially implementation of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) features. As a Staff Software Engineer, you’re a clear communicator and expert in your domain, ready to work on multi-month projects. You’ll contribute to the team through code review, mentoring, and discussion.

What you’ll do: 

  • Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  • Lead projects that improve the stability, security, and performance of Firefox.
  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers.
  • Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.
  • Work with a geographically-distributed development team.
  • Interact with teams throughout the organization.

What you’ll bring: 

  • 7+ years of overall software engineering experience.
  • Experience with desktop application development on Windows with C++.
  • Advanced knowledge of C and C++ and a solid understanding of assembly language such as x64, x86, or arm64.
  • Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset.
  • Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment.
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Welcoming differences
    • Being relationship-minded
    • Practicing responsible participation
    • Having grit

Bonus Points for experience with:

  • Enterprise DLP development or deployment
  • Open-source contributions or personal engineering projects

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission.  We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Please note: this position is only available for students who are proficient in the Dutch language!  

Bij WPP Media zijn we het wereldwijde mediacollectief van WPP, volledig gebouwd voor het AI-tijdperk. We bundelen het beste platform, de meest getalenteerde mensen en de sterkste partners om innovatieve oplossingen te creëren. Ons doel? Merken elke dag ongeëvenaarde groei bieden. Dit fundament vinden we in onze gedeelde kernwaarden:

We’re Extraordinary: We verleggen grenzen, dagen het gewone denken uit en doorbreken de status-quo in ons streven naar innovatie en groei.

We’re Open: We bouwen vertrouwen en begrip door naadloos samen te werken – met onze teams, klanten en partners.

We’re Optimistic: Een 'growth mindset' zit in ons DNA. We omarmen verandering als dé manier om het beste uit onszelf te halen.

Klaar om de social media-wereld te veroveren? Word onze Stagiair Social Media bij StudioM!

Droom jij ervan om te werken voor A-merken als Mentos, Katja en Tempo-Team? Krijg jij energie van het creëren van viral content en het spotten van de nieuwste TikTok-trends? Dan hebben we de perfecte match! Bij StudioM, het creatieve hart van WPP Media, zoeken we een gedreven Stagiair Social Media die ons team komt versterken.

Wie zijn wij?

StudioM is een uniek collectief van creatievelingen die verslaafd zijn aan digital design, contentcreatie en influencer marketing. We zijn onderdeel van WPP Media en werken vanuit die basis voor de gaafste merken. Je komt terecht in ons jonge, dynamische en supergezellige social media team. Verwacht flexibele kantoordagen, legendarische teamuitjes en een sfeer waar jouw input écht telt.

Jouw missie, mocht je die accepteren:

Als Stagiair Social Media ben jij de motor achter de online aanwezigheid van onze klanten. Je mond dichthouden? Geen optie! We willen jouw frisse ideeën.

  • Content is King (or Queen): Je werkt mee aan ijzersterke contentkalenders en strategieën.
  • Trendspotting: Jij bent onze ogen en oren online. Je weet wat er speelt in de community, welke trends booming zijn en hoe we daarop kunnen inspelen.
  • Community Love: Je helpt mee met het managen van de social communities en bent de stem van het merk.
  • Create & Activate: Je brainstormt mee over de vetste activaties en campagnes die engagement door het dak laten gaan.
  • Data-Driven: Je duikt in de data om insights te vinden die onze strategieën nóg slimmer maken.

Dit ben jij (toch?):

Jij bent allesbehalve een muurbloempje. Social media is jouw natuurlijke habitat en je schermtijd bewijst dat.

  • Je ademt social media, kent alle ins en outs van TikTok en Instagram en wordt wild van het creëren van nieuwe content.
  • Je hebt een proactieve, ‘hands-on’ mentaliteit. Een nieuwe update of trend? Jij ziet kansen en wilt meteen aan de slag.
  • Je bent creatief, zelfstandig en leergierig (HBO-denkniveau).
  • De Nederlandse taal heeft voor jou geen geheimen.
  • Je staat te popelen om te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen in een high-paced omgeving.

Wat bieden wij? De beste start van je carrière!

  • Een uitdagende stage voor minimaal 5 maanden (4-5 dagen per week), startend in januari/februari 2027 (startdatum in overleg).
  • Stagevergoeding: Een mooie vergoeding van €450 bruto per maand (op basis van fulltime).
  • Flexibiliteit: De mogelijkheid om deels thuis te werken en je uren flexibel in te delen.
  • Toplocatie: Werken in een inspirerende omgeving in Amsterdam met bijna 120 leuke collega's, inclusief voordelige lunch en een barista voor je dagelijkse cafeïneshot.
  • Fantastische merken om je portfolio een enorme boost te geven.

Let op: een vereiste voor deze stage is dat je gedurende de gehele periode ingeschreven staat bij een onderwijsinstelling.

Ben jij onze nieuwe social media rockstar?

Voel je de energie? Wacht dan niet langer! Klik op die solliciteerknop en stuur ons je cv en een motivatie waar de passie vanaf spat. Vertel ons waarom jij dé perfecte aanvulling bent op ons team.

We kunnen niet wachten om van je te horen!

From strategy to execution: Stay close to the business, with opportunities to move from market analysis and strategic decisions to concrete local initiatives and outcomes. Déjà bien implantée au Royaume-Uni, cette entité propose un ensemble de solutions techniques : installation de panneaux photovoltaïques, de bornes de recharge pour véhicules électriques et de systèmes de chauffage décarboné, le tout avec une approche centrée sur la qualité, l’innovation et la satisfaction client. Notre objectif est clair : aider les particuliers à réduire leurs factures énergétiques tout en participant activement à la transition énergétique. Et aujourd’hui on a besoin de toi pour propulser notre croissance ! Dans le cadre du lancement et du déploiement de nos pompes à chaleur en France, nous recherchons notre premier·ère Superviseur·ise CVC/HVAC pour superviser les installations de nos pompes à chaleur air-eau. Nous recherchons une personne passionnée, ayant de l’expérience dans l’installation de pompes à chaleur et/ou systèmes de chauffage et désireuse de nous aider à développer cette activité en France. Il s’agit d’un poste sur le terrain couvrant la région d’Amiens, mais tu seras également amené·e à travailler depuis ton domicile ou depuis notre bureau de Lille lorsque cela sera nécessaire. Ce que tu feras - Tu nous aideras à mettre en place la structure technique de notre département dédié aux pompes à chaleur en France - Tu veilleras à la qualité et au bon fonctionnement des installations réalisées par nos partenaires locaux - Tu seras sur le terrain pour visiter les chantiers et t’assurer de leur bon déroulement - Tu seras en mesure d’apporter une assistance technique pour résoudre directement tout problème identifié sur place - Tu auras un esprit « dépanneur » pour trouver des solutions aux défis rencontrés et les résoudre à ton échelle - Tu mettras à profit tes connaissances et ton expérience en matière d’installations de pompes à chaleur pour garantir une expérience fluide et exceptionnelle - Tu conseilleras nos clients et tu les aideras à mettre en places les bonnes pratique de réduction des émissions carbone - Tu examineras les cahiers des charges techniques et les plans techniques de nos pompes à chaleur, et tu pourras participer à leur élaboration/amélioration continue, en lien avec les équipes techniques & métiers du groupe Profil recherché - Tu as au moins 3 ans d’expérience dans l’installation et la maintenance de systèmes de pompes à chaleur aérothermiques - Tu es disponible et prêt·e à te déplacer dans la région d’Amiens et le Nord de la France - Tu es un·e technicien·ne expérimenté·e, notamment en plomberie et chauffage, et tu possèdes des connaissances en conception de systèmes de chauffage ; tu es en mesure de dépanner toi-même et d’intervenir techniquement sur place sur les chantiers - Tu sais examiner et être force de proposition sur des cahiers des charges techniques ainsi que des plans mécaniques - Tu as l'esprit entrepreneur : tu rejoins un nouveau projet où "tout est à faire". Tu n’as pas peur de partir d'une feuille blanche, tester, apprendre et avancer en autonomie. - Tu es proactif·ve et rigoureux·se, tu sais organiser ton activité en autonomie, en optimisant au fur et à mesure, notamment en mettant en place des processus clairs et automatisés - Tu as le goût du challenge, tu aimes aller sur le terrain ; tu n'as pas peur de te confronter aux artisans et de les aider à surmonter les irritants rencontrés. Doté·e d'un fort capital sympathie, tu sais fédérer tes interlocuteurs et les faire devenir de véritables ambassadeurs d’Octopus Energy ! Pré-requis & Qualifications - Permis voiture en cours de validité - Diplôme(s) de niveau CAP/BEP, ou VAE de niveau équivalent - Avoir travaillé précédemment dans des entreprises certifiées RGE & Qualibat - Maîtrise de l’anglais technique à l’écrit & l’oral (niveau B1-B2) - Habilitation électrique (BR NF C18-510) Ce sera également un plus si : - Tu es à l’aise avec les outils & le numérique, notamment Excel - Tu as de l’expérience avec la partie “électrique” des pompes à chaleur - Tu possèdes l’habilitation électrique BR Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailler pour nous ? Tu as vu le salaire ou la fourchette prévu·e pour ce poste mais tu aimerais en discuter ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Nous aurons l’occasion de t’en dire plus sur la manière dont nous avons défini le salaire et sur les autres avantages dont tu pourras bénéficier si tu nous rejoins ! Sache enfin que nous pouvons avoir un certain degré de flexibilité, car nous ne voudrions jamais que le salaire soit une raison pour laquelle quelqu’un·e ne postule pas chez Octopus - ce qui est le plus important pour nous est de trouver le bon Octofit ! Certifiée depuis 2024 et 4e en 2025, Octopus Energy France est classée 1ère sur plus de 200 entreprises au classement Great Place to Work 2026 ! Cela reflète bien notre engagement pour un environnement de travail épanouissant ! Nous sommes une organisation où les gens apprennent, décident et construisent plus rapidement. Où ils travaillent de manière autonome, avec des gens extraordinaires, sur des projets qui innovent. Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment ! Chez Octopus, nous cherchons des personnes foncièrement bienveillantes et empathiques. L’égalité des chances nous tient à cœur et nous veillons à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et équitable. Nous t’invitons à postuler, quels que soient ton âge, genre, vie conjugale, couleur, handicap, grossesse ou parentalité, origine, convictions religieuses ou orientation sexuelle. description: Ben jij ready voor Change? Bij Change zoeken we een Talent acquisition Lead die recruitment naar een hoger niveau brengt. Je werft zelf actief mee en bent daarnaast de senior op de afdeling: je coacht junior recruiters, brengt structuur aan in de dagelijkse operatie en helpt het team groeien in eigenaarschap, kwaliteit en resultaat. Daarmee maak je meteen helder: dit is geen gewone recruiterrol, maar een combinatie van zelf doen, richting geven en mensen beter maken. Hier ga je werken: Bij Change kom je terecht in een energieke en snelgroeiende organisatie waar ontwikkeling, samenwerking en beweging centraal staan. We werken voor bekende merken zoals Marktplaats, Odido en Eneco en zorgen iedere dag voor de beste klantbeleving. Onze organisatie groeit hard en recruitment speelt daarin een belangrijke rol. We zoeken daarom iemand die zelf stevig in de werving staat, maar ook het recruitmentteam verder helpt ontwikkelen. Je werkt nauw samen met teamleads, management, HR en collega-recruiters. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid, ruimte om mee te denken en de kans om zichtbaar impact te maken op de groei van Change. Waar ben je verantwoordelijk voor? Actieve sourcing en hunting Je zoekt actief naar commercieel talent via LinkedIn, jobboards en netwerken. Je weet latent werkzoekenden te vinden en te enthousiasmeren voor Change. Coaching en ontwikkeling van het recruitmentteam Je begeleidt en coacht recruiters in sourcing, selectie, stakeholdermanagement en kandidaatcommunicatie. Je deelt kennis en helpt het team groeien in kwaliteit en eigenaarschap. Operationele aansturing Je brengt structuur aan, bewaakt de voortgang van vacatures en helpt het team prioriteiten stellen. Businesspartner voor sales en operatie Je werkt nauw samen met teamleads, management en HR en vertaalt personeelsbehoeften naar effectieve recruitmentacties. Candidate experience Je zorgt voor een professioneel en persoonlijk recruitmentproces waarin kandidaten zich gezien voelen. Procesverbetering en data Je optimaliseert recruitmentprocessen en gebruikt data om resultaten en effectiviteit te verbeteren. Talentpools Je bouwt aan talentpools voor commerciële en specialistische functies, zodat we ook op de lange termijn succesvol kunnen blijven werven. Wij vinden het belangrijk dat wij bij elkaar passen. Herken jij jezelf in onze kernwaarden? Eerlijk – Je communiceert open, duidelijk en betrouwbaar. Beweging – Je pakt aan, denkt vooruit en brengt energie in elk project. Anders – Je ziet mogelijkheden, durft te vernieuwen en houdt het praktisch. Expertise – Je werkt gestructureerd, deelt kennis en maakt dingen af. Wat breng je mee? Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen recruitment, bij voorkeur in een dynamische, commerciële of snelgroeiende organisatie. Je hebt ervaring met actieve sourcing en weet hoe je latent werkzoekenden benadert en overtuigt. Je vindt het leuk om junior recruiters te coachen, te begeleiden en beter te maken in hun vak. Je hebt ambitie om leiding te geven. Je bent sterk in stakeholdermanagement en schakelt makkelijk met teamleads, management, HR en recruiters. Je brengt structuur, overzicht en rust in een omgeving waar veel tegelijk gebeurt. Je hebt ervaring met interviewtechnieken, ATS-systemen en recruitmentdata. Je weet hoe je commercieel talent herkent en kunt beoordelen op salesdrive, overtuigingskracht, eigenaarschap en resultaatgerichtheid. Je bent zelfstandig, proactief en krijgt energie van targets, groei en resultaat. Je durft mensen aan te spreken op eigenaarschap, opvolging en kwaliteit. Je denkt mee over processen, maar blijft niet hangen in plannen. Jij zorgt dat dingen gebeuren. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend in de Nederlandse taal. Ervaring met employer branding of doelgroepgerichte arbeidsmarktcommunicatie is mooi meegenomen. Wat wij jou bieden! Een uitdagende functie binnen een snelgroeiende en dynamische organisatie. Een salaris tussen €4.500 en €5.500 per maand (op fulltime basis). Een aantrekkelijke bonusstructuur op basis van prestaties en resultaten. Een contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week. Km vergoeding of NS businesscard voor jouw woon- werk verkeer. Veel ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling. Een ambitieus en energiek team waarin samenwerking centraal staat. De mogelijkheid om écht impact te maken op de groei van onze commerciële organisatie. Ready for Change? Zie jij het als een uitdaging om zelf sterke commerciële kandidaten aan Change te verbinden én een recruitmentteam verder te ontwikkelen? Dan leren we je graag kennen. Solliciteer en ontdek hoe jij recruitment bij Change verder in beweging kunt brengen. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: A Eurostar, nous souhaitons vous offrir la meilleure expérience pour vos voyages en Europe. Piloter l'ensemble du processus de recrutement : brief, sourcing, présélection, entretiens, évaluation et sélection des candidats. Accompagner les managers dans la conduite des entretiens et la prise de décision. Garantir une expérience candidat de qualité à chaque étape du parcours. Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de recrutement et proposer des axes d'amélioration Marque Employeur et Expérience Candidat Participer au développement de l'attractivité d'Eurostar auprès des talents. Onboarding et Parcours Collaborateur Coordonner l'intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs. Organiser et participer aux différentes sessions d'accueil. Recueillir les retours des nouveaux arrivants et contribuer à l'amélioration du parcours d'intégration. Participer aux démarches d'offboarding et aux entretiens de sortie. Support RH aux Managers Répondre aux demandes RH courantes et accompagner les managers sur les sujets liés aux ressources humaines. Participer à certains processus RH tels que la performance, le développement des collaborateurs ou le suivi des effectifs. Assurer une présence RH de proximité sur les différents sites français. VOTRE PROFIL Diplômé(e) d'un Master en Ressources Humaines ou équivalent. 2 à 3 ans d'expérience en gestion de recrutement de bout en bout. Bonne connaissance du droit social français et de la réglementation du travail. Capacité à construire et déployer des stratégies d'attraction de talents. Très bonnes capacités d'organisation et de gestion des priorités. Excellentes compétences relationnelles et de communication. Esprit d'analyse, sens du service et goût pour la collaboration. Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement international en constante transformation.
